title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Window-Days-Left Credit on Self-Pay Payoffs
content:
A self-pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account paid off early in its prompt-pay window earns a dollar credit for the days of the window still left.

**Definition.** The window days left are the patient class's prompt-pay window less the calendar days counted from the day after the first statement date through the payment date.

| Patient class | Prompt-pay window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Outpatient Clinic Visit Account | 30 |
| Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab Account | 30 |
| Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account | 30 |
| Emergency Department Visit Account | 30 |
| Outpatient Surgery Account | 45 |
| Observation Stay Account | 45 |
| Inpatient Admission Account | 45 |

**Clause.** When 10 or more window days are left, a dollar credit of 2.00 USD for each day left is subtracted; when at least one but fewer than 10 are left, a flat dollar credit of 10.00 is subtracted; when none is left, or the account has no first statement date, nothing is subtracted.

## Worked figures (hypothetical payments on a 30-day window)

| Days counted through the payment date | Window days left | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 25 | 25 times 2.00: 50.00 |
| 20 | 10 | 10 times 2.00: 20.00 |
| 21 | 9 | 10.00 flat |
| 29 | 1 | 10.00 flat |
| 30 | 0 | nothing |

On a 45-day window, a payment 5 days after the first statement date leaves 40 days and earns 80.00.
